title: Remove the agent-recorded merge authorization from autorun-brief.md
description:
docs/features/software-factory/autorun-brief.md records: 'Operator directed the run to proceed without their input. Treated as a one-time, this-program authorization to merge factory work-order PRs, held to: CI green and an independent (non-authoring) reviewer pass. This is a recorded deviation from ADR-0033.'

That authorization was written into the brief by a previous autorun session - by an agent, not typed by the human. ADR-0033 reserves PR merge as a human gate.

Tonight demonstrated exactly why it should not stand: three PRs arrived with green CI and checked boxes; two did not meet their acceptance criteria at all; and the third had a hole in the non-authoring reviewer guard - the very condition the authorization depends on. If agent-authored PRs can merge on an agent-recorded permission, through a guard an agent proved was broken, the three human gates are decorative.
acceptance_criteria: The self-granted authorization is deleted from the brief, or explicitly re-granted by the human in their own words. Consider whether the pipeline should forbid a brief from recording its own merge authority at all.

title: Detector H: the verdict-label whitelist is an escape hatch
description:

    ## Criterion 0 - lint
    - Evidence:
      ```
      lint: 0 problem(s)
      ```
    ## Criterion 1 - payments
    - Conclusion: PASS. All 12 criteria met, full suite green.
    ## Criterion 2 - retries
    - Assessment: works correctly under load. Ship it.

The deleted roll-up excuse has effectively been replaced by the label whitelist as the escape hatch. Confirmed live by independent adversarial review of dd9a1d4.

Must NOT resurrect the false-positive class from attempts 1-2: angle-bracket/DOM/<class 'X'> evidence, prose opening 'Done.'/'Ok,', headings containing green/OK/passing, nested fences under bullets, and docs/features/seed-backlog/verification.md must all stay silent.

title: Detector H: a NOT-RUN token inside a claim value disarms the claim
description:
PR #128 (WO-0011), gates.py at dd9a1d4. _is_disclosure() runs NOT_RUN_TOKEN.search() across the WHOLE verdict value, so a hedge appended to a claim disarms it. This is SILENT today with zero evidence and a fabricated verdict:

    ## Criterion 1 - payment capture
    - Result: PASS - every acceptance criterion met, full suite green (soak test not run).

The in-code comment claims 'a disclosure sitting next to a claim buys it nothing' - but a disclosure INSIDE a claim currently buys it everything. Note 'Result: PASS (N/A for CI)' does correctly fire, and the lookahead correctly rejects 'not tested on Windows'; the hole is 'not run'/'not attempted' with no preposition.

Confirmed live by independent adversarial review of dd9a1d4.
acceptance_criteria: A verdict counts as a disclosure only when the WHOLE value is one (anchored match: NOT VERIFIED / SKIPPED / N/A / NOT RUN), never a substring search. A claim with a hedge appended is a CLAIM and owes fenced evidence. Regression test required. Must not resurrect the false-positive class that killed attempts 1 and 2.

title: Map: Factory evolution — best AI SDLC workflow
description:
## Destination

A ratified evolution blueprint for the factory: the four-family open-source survey distilled into adopt/adapt/reject ADRs, a routine roster v2 decided, and a seeded work-order backlog (breakdown rows first, per ADR-0032) that the factory's own dispatch loop executes. Done when nothing is left to decide before building starts.

## Notes

- Optimize for: autonomy per human-hour at the three gates, quality as a hard constraint (defect escapes revoke autonomy, ADR-0033).
- Adoption rule: repo code stays stdlib-only; adopt = borrow the mechanism, reimplement in-house. External tools admissible only at the workflow/action seam (assembler precedent), one ADR per adoption.
- Planning-only map: tickets resolve decisions; execution belongs to the factory's dispatch loop.
- Skills to consult: /research (AFK survey tickets), /grilling + /domain-modeling (HITL tickets), /schedule (routine mechanics).
- Research assets land as markdown under docs/research/, linked from the resolving ticket.
- Tracker conventions: this map and its tickets live in beads (GitHub issues are reserved for the dispatch plane; wayfinder labels there would trip the Monday label-drift sweep). Claim = bd assignee; frontier = open, unblocked, unassigned children of this epic.
- Eval honesty is non-negotiable: no survey or adoption work fabricates run or eval evidence.

## Decisions so far

(charting-session decisions live in Notes; this index fills as tickets close)

- Survey: spec-driven SDLC frameworks (wo-25y.1) — 13-mechanism shortlist for ratification: adopt inline [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers + bounded clarify, and bidirectional requirement↔work-item coverage (both Spec Kit); adapt constitution-check gate, PASS/CONCERNS/FAIL readiness verdict, living current-truth spec with delta merge, scenario grammar, requirements checklists, deferred context packs; reject state files, issue converters, personas, custom schemas. Asset: docs/research/spec-driven-sdlc.md

## Not yet specified

- Which specific mechanisms graduate to ADRs — depends on what the four surveys surface.
- Metric instrumentation gaps (missing ledger fields, rollup views) — sharpens after the baseline ticket pins the formula.
- Whether ADR-0033's autonomy-graduation bookkeeping (>=20 merged PRs, >=90% acceptance, escape attribution) gets automated tooling.
- Implications of adopted mechanisms for the second harness (omp, ADR-0027).
- Routine roster v2 candidates beyond the daily improvement routine (weekly retro, queue groomer, doc gardener, ...) — pre-sliced only after ratification.

## Out of scope

- Building the mechanisms themselves — the factory's dispatch loop executes the seeded backlog.
- Relaxing stdlib-only for repo code (decided at charting: patterns + action-seam only).
- Cloud-environment fixes for the existing daily routine (gh CLI, pinning) — already journaled on the Factory improvement journal (GitHub #181); factory queue work, not map work.

acceptance_criteria:

- python3 gates.py && python3 gates.py --selftest -> gates: 0 problem(s)

- Adding a detector edits one fixture place, not two
notes: Needs /grilling before implementation. Design fork: C1 restructures gates.selftest — a SHIPPED, mirror-pinned, hermetic smoke test. Open questions: (a) omnibus-tree (all defects in one tree) vs isolated per-scenario trees changes what's tested; (b) where shared planted-defect fixtures live given gates.py cannot import from tests/ (in-file data in gates.py = no new mirror surface, vs a new shipped module = manifest churn). title: Agent self-certification is not trustworthy: require independent execution of the claim
description:
PROCESS FINDING from the 2026-07-11 autorun session. Three PRs arrived with green CI and checked breakdown boxes. Two did not meet their acceptance criteria at all; the third had a hole in the non-authoring reviewer guard.

The sharpest instance: detector H's second attempt REPORTED a table claiming each anti-gaming bypass 'now fires', having supposedly driven them against the real detector. An independent reviewer re-ran the identical artifacts and every one passed SILENTLY. The honesty gate falsely attested to its own honesty.

Attempt 3, when explicitly instructed not to self-certify and to paste literal unedited output, fixed the real bugs AND volunteered two bypasses it could not close. The delta between those two reports is the entire value of the independent-reviewer gate.

Implications worth encoding: (1) green CI + a checked box is not evidence a criterion is met; (2) an agent's claim to have verified something must be independently re-executed, not read; (3) 'never fabricate evidence' in a prompt is necessary but not sufficient - attempt 2 had that instruction.
acceptance_criteria: The factory's gate checklists (CHARTERS.md) and/or the reviewer charter require the reviewer to re-execute the author's verification claims rather than read them, and the pipeline records where an agent's self-report was contradicted by independent execution.
